title: 2026 NFL Cut Candidates for All 32 Teams: James Conner, Geno Smith on the chopping block

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 2026 NFL Cut Candidates for All 32 Teams: James Conner, Geno Smith on the chopping block
sources.description: James Conner and Geno Smith are both former starters on rebuilding teams who could be cut for salary cap relief in 2026. Meanwhile, the fates of Brandon Aiyuk and Tyreek Hill have already been decided.
